en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard with an oval-framed street scene showing a lively European city street with cobblestones, horse-drawn carts, early automobiles, and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. Multi‑story historic buildings line both sides of the street, with shop signs visible, including one reading "HIRSCH ADLER." A church or tower with a spire rises in the distant background. The caption at the bottom reads in Hungarian: "Kolozsvár. Wesselényi Miklós-utca."
